content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Jennifer Martin (E033) requests admin access to Payroll.

There are two notes with conflicting information:
- Note 1: role Analyst, employment type full_time, recommendation write. Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist role, so admin not permitted. Max for full-time is write.
- Note 2: role Analyst, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Contractors never get admin; with basic training max is read.

The security note says security DB is authoritative, and there is a conflict. Note 2 says "note conflicts; security DB is authoritative."

The approver must use the information available. Which note to trust? The security agent says security DB is authoritative, noting the conflict. So employment type = contractor, security training = basic.

Access policy: contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. With basic training: read. Requested admin exceeds read, so grant maximum = read.

Actually wait - the note says "with basic training max is read" but policy says contractors can have read, or write if advanced training. Basic training => read.

So decision: read.

Submit with reason.
